//: Template for appsettings.json. Copy to appsettings.json and fill in real values. appsettings.json is gitignored because it holds live database credentials and the impersonation password - never commit it. Prefer dotnet User Secrets in development and environment variables in deployed environments.

ConnectionStrings.//: Encrypt and TrustServerCertificate are applied in code by Startup.BuildSqlConnectionString when absent here, so a missing setting cannot break a deployment. Stating them explicitly still wins over the code defaults. Encrypt must stay on: the production database is reached over the public internet.

Database.//: Set to false once the SQL Server presents a certificate the application host trusts; that restores full chain validation. Defaults to true in code because the current servers use self-signed certificates.

Impersonation.//: Project-admin master password used by the is_global_pass path in Login.cshtml.cs. Must be a distinct secret, not reused from any database credential. If absent or blank the feature is disabled (fails closed). In deployed environments supply it as the environment variable Impersonation__GlobalPassword instead of a file.
